description: tensor_dev_missions.status runtime vocabulary. Single source for api/tensor_missions.py MISSION_STATUSES/TERMINAL (G-A side 1). Initial DB CHECK in migrations/086 (7 states); migrations/095_mission_lifecycle widened it to the full set below; migrations/100_pr_merge_gate added awaiting_pr_merge (owner 2026-11-05: a dev mission that pushed a PR is done only when the PR merges — success is provisional between PR open and merge); migrations/103_mission_reopened added reopened (SPEC §4.2: a post-acceptance defect/evidence-invalidation/reversed-review brings the mission back through a formal REOPENED state triggered by an independent governance actor who cites the original acceptance record, instead of an out-of-band daemon silently reviving it). Any change requires a version bump and green contract tests on BOTH repos.
